## Final Answer

**Yes.** This image does show an opened abdomen with diffuse, bulky nodular tumor filling the peritoneal cavity, and the gross appearance is consistent with both widespread leiomyosarcoma and peritoneal carcinomatosis. On this type of macroscopic/surgical photograph, the two entities look essentially the same—multiple coalescent, lobulated, grayish-tan nodular masses covering the serosal surfaces—and the image alone cannot reliably distinguish one from the other. Definitive separation would require histopathology, not visual inspection of the gross specimen.
